title: Perfection of a specified finite affine Cech complex
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be proper, locally of finite presentation and quasi-compact, and let $F$ be a finitely presented $\mathcal O_X$-module flat over $f$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Assume injective resolutions in $X.\mathrm{Modules}$. Fix an affine open $U\subseteq T$ and the supplied derived localization of $\mathcal O_U$-modules and its localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. For any finite affine covering $V:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to (f^{-1}U).\mathrm{Opens}$, the derived image of the explicit complex $C(f|_U,F|_{f^{-1}U},V)$ [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model] is perfect on $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. No existence of a complex or base-change comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tags 01XB, 01XD and 01FK (derived affine Cech comparison); 0B91(2) and proof of 0A1H (proper perfect direct image)

proof.text: Restrict f and F to the inverse image of U. Properness, finite presentation and quasi-compactness are preserved under this open base change. The private flatOver_restrict argument identifies affine opens with their images under the two open immersions, uses morphismRestrict_appLE to identify the scalar actions, and applies the original flatness hypothesis. Choose only a standard source localization; keep the supplied base and localized-open localizations.

Apply the explicit derived Cech comparison to the restricted module and the supplied finite affine cover. This identifies the specified complex, not merely its cohomology, with the restricted derived direct image.

Apply perfection of proper direct image of a relatively flat single module. At each point keep its strictly perfect local representative and compose its derived isomorphism with the restriction of the Cech comparison. This proves the unchanged IsPerfect conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01XB, 01XD, 01FK, 0B91(2), 0A1H; N3 stage-3 reduction using independent source and base localization universes
